Biden criticizes Trump as 'loser' over corruption and vanity projects

US President Joe Biden delivered a scathing speech in Maryland, criticizing Donald Trump as a "loser" and highlighting alleged corruption and vanity projects. Biden specifically condemned Trump's handling of January 6th insurrectionists, stating they should be jailed instead of compensated. The remarks focused on Trump's perceived vanity and foreign policy failures.
